sections.label: IX · The costs
sections.h2: What it costs to sell a home in B.C.
sections.lead: These are common costs when you sell, from the BC Financial Services Authority (BCFSA) list:

items: Legal or notary fees for the title transfer
Legal fees to discharge your mortgage
Any prepayment penalty from your lender for paying the mortgage off early
Your share of the current year's property taxes, if not already paid

blocks.d: If you sell a home you've owned for less than 730 days, the BC home flipping tax may apply. The rate is 20% of the profit for homes sold within 365 days, and it drops to zero by day 730. Some exemptions apply, and a return may be due within 90 days of the sale.
If a buyer cancels during the three business day cooling-off period, they pay you a fee of 0.25% of the offer price.
For tax questions about your own sale, talk to an accountant.
